goal: Move official B performance toward 0.70; development gains alone cannot complete that goal.
hypothesis: The all-span detector has many high-confidence boundary false positives. A token BIO softmax objective directly learns starts/continuations/background and may provide better precision/recall before semantic normalization.

parameters.loss: Unweighted token cross entropy, O/B/I; padding, special tokens and clipped/unencoded gold regions ignored.
parameters.polarity: Both positive and NO spans teach mention boundaries; polarity is assigned by the existing local negation rule during linking.

selection: Use fixed completed epoch 5. Compare the four predefined inference configurations on pilot folds 0/1; advance the highest mean configuration satisfying the gate to folds 2/3/4 without retuning. All evaluations are repeated development, not independent tests.
environment: Existing validated .venv and pinned BiomedBERT; unchanged dependency stack. GPU 0 and GPU 2, two CPU threads per process, FP16.
output_policy: Fresh work/span_ner/bio-* directories; original checkpoints and predictions remain untouched.

numerical_repair.change: Use a smaller initial GradScaler scale; require the same smoke gate before formal runs.
